title: ‘It’s Time for Breturn’: 10 Years On, Mehdi Makes the Case for Reversing Brexit
author: Mehdi Hasan
content:
Ten years ago, the UK voted to leave the European Union. It was, as **Mehdi**
[writes in his latest piece for ](https://zeteo.uk/p/its-time-for-
breturn-10-years-on)**[Zeteo UK](https://zeteo.uk/p/its-time-for-
breturn-10-years-on) **below, "perhaps the most astonishing act of voluntary
self-harm in modern British history."
